description: Implementation of the ShippingService interface, providing methods to configure, retrieve, and compute shipping options, quotes, and configurations in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ShippingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing shipping-related business logic such as retrieving configurations, calculating quotes, and managing supported countries.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping configuration for a given merchant store, parsed from JSON stored in merchant configuration.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves external shipping module configuration for a specific module code.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration for a specific shipping quote module.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the provided shipping configuration into merchant configuration storage.

methods.name: saveCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves custom configuration for a shipping module for a store.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Returns a list of available shipping modules supported for the store's region.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates and saves configuration for a specific shipping quote module.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a shipping quote module configuration from storage.

methods.name: removeCustomShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a custom shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Retrieves all shipping modules configured for the store.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates and returns a summary object representing the shipping calculation results.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Calculates and returns a shipping quote based on the store, delivery, products, and language.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns list of supported country codes for shipping for a store.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Provides a list of countries eligible for shipping to, based on configuration and store region.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Updates the list of supported countries in configuration.

methods.name: calculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Private method that sums up total order price based on products and pricing service.

methods.name: getPackagesDetails
methods.description: Returns package details such as box or item packages based on configuration.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if the shopping cart items require shipping based on product type.
